chapter.v:
Praise the
Lord! Praise him, servants of the Lord! Praise the Lord as he is!

Let the
Lord's nature be praised, now and forever.

Let everyone
everywhere, from the east to the west, praise the Lord as he is!

The Lord
rules supreme over all nations; his glory extends higher than the heavens.

Who is
like the Lord our God? He is the one who lives on high, seated on his throne.

He has
to stoop low to look down on the heavens and the earth.

He helps
the poor up from the dust; he lifts the needy from the dump.

He gives
them positions of honor together with important leaders, with leaders of his own people.

He makes
the childless woman happy in her home by giving her children. Praise the Lord!
